description: The key experiment: 15 questions run on BOTH the vector-only baseline and the GraphRAG navigator. Each case pre-loads the user's profile (and completed steps) into memory, so the question is answered in one turn. Gold answers: for 'lookup', the expected section text; for 'multi_step' and 'progress', the ordered plan computed from the hand-reviewed graph.

questions.question: What is the CAC registration fee for a business name?
expected_sections: Requirement: Business name registration — sole proprietorship

questions.question: What documents does NAFDAC need for product registration of my drink?
What are the PCN siting rules for my pharmacy premises?
expected_sections: Requirement: Premises meet PCN siting and structure standards

questions.question: What must my website's privacy notice contain?
expected_sections: Requirement: Publish a privacy policy, privacy notice and cookie notice
